framework_lessons: Separate funding access from intrinsic asset value.
assessment: Strongest concrete results were bitcoin breakout and rapid corporate accumulation. The bank-financing discussion has useful balance-sheet intuition but bank purchases are not identical to central-bank QE. Relative valuation and stocks-versus-bonds preferences lack fixed horizons; dividend growth should be distinguished from investor returns.

Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
